_meta.note: GroupKey.MinimumLength = 8 is a typo-guard, not access control, by its own source comment (src/TarkovCompanion.GroupServer/GroupKey.cs). No attempt counter or lockout exists anywhere in Program.cs.

scenario.costPerAttempt: one unauthenticated HTTP request, no backoff, no CAPTCHA, no per-IP counter
scenario.successCondition: any key that happens to match a live group's key returns 200 with that group's member list, indistinguishable from a legitimate lookup (docs/GROUP_RELAY.md: 'A 401 does not mean a wrong key').
